title: Log in and the profile menu work on a Space website's own domain, through a signed handoff

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];if(!/site-visitor-handoff/.test(r('lib/sites/site-visitor.ts')))miss.push('signed handoff');if(!/readVisitorHandoff/.test(r('app/hosted/[host]/visitor/enter/route.ts')))miss.push('site enter route');if(!/readVisitorCookie/.test(r('app/hosted/[host]/visitor/me/route.ts')))miss.push('site me route');if(!/signVisitorExit/.test(r('app/hosted/[host]/visitor/exit/route.ts')))miss.push('site exit route');if(!/signVisitorHandoff/.test(r('app/auth/site-login/route.ts')))miss.push('Frequency login route');if(!/readVisitorExit/.test(r('app/auth/site-exit/route.ts')))miss.push('Frequency exit route');if(!/\/_s\/me/.test(r('components/sites/network-header-tools.tsx')))miss.push('header reads the site');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-1207: missing '+miss.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Coordinator ask 2026-10-21 after #3763: thegrouplocal.com is a custom domain, so Frequency's session cookie never reaches it and the header's profile menu always read signed out. Fix: Log in goes to /auth/site-login on Frequency (sign in there if needed), which mints a 60-second HMAC token bound to the site's host and sends the person to /_s/enter on the site; the site keeps a signed host-only HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax display cookie (name, handle, photo only, no Frequency session), the header reads it client-side from /_s/me, and Sign out POSTs /_s/exit, which clears the cookie and sends a 60-second exit token to /auth/site-exit so Frequency's session ends too. Destination hosts come from the Space's own bound domain, never from the request; handoff lands only on Home or a single-segment page. Not enforced: single use of a token (needs storage); mitigated by 60-second expiry, host binding, no-referrer, and the token granting display identity only.
